laws.rule: Smoking or dropping cigarette butts is prohibited (except in designated areas) on Phra Ae, Khlong Dao and Khok Kwang beaches on Ko Lanta. The penalty is up to one year's jail and/or a fine of up to THB 100,000. DMCR Order 864/2563 (2020) covered these for two years; a later renewal has not been confirmed here.
laws.heading: Department of Marine and Coastal Resources, beach smoking order

layers.authority: Department of National Parks, Wildlife and Plant Conservation (as reported by the Tourism Authority of Thailand)
layers.process: Marine national parks in Krabi, including Hat Noppharat Thara-Mu Ko Phi Phi and Mu Ko Lanta, have used electronic entry tickets since October 2025. TAT advises buying the ticket in advance and having your passport ready.

layers.authority: Department of National Parks, Wildlife and Plant Conservation (as reported by the Tourism Authority of Thailand)
layers.process: Maya Bay on Ko Phi Phi Le closes each monsoon season for recovery. TAT reports it welcomed visitors back on 1 October 2026. The exact closure dates for 2027 were not found on an official page.

sources.title: The Andaman Opens Its Doors Again (20 October 2026)
sources.supports: e-tickets since October 2025, Maya Bay reopening 1 October 2026 (read directly 2026-11-05)
